caption: The drawing depicts a bronze-colored statuette of a woman standing on a circular base. The woman is shown in a contrapposto pose with her right hand resting on her hip and her left elbow bent so that her hand supports her tilted head. She is wearing a draped dress that wraps around her body and falls down to her knees, revealing her legs. The statuette features details such as folds in the dress and the contours of the woman's body, with the bronze coloring highlighting these shapes. The surface of the base appears slightly textured, and the figure is rendered with shading to give a three-dimensional effect. The background is plain and untextured, and there is a faint signature in the lower right-hand corner.
title: Toy Bank
